release-coordinator: kicking off v2026.4 -> eu1. staged: 10% then 50 in 20m. deploy-bot: canary started on eu1-canary-pool, probes: kv-prefill, heartbeat, embed.
deploy-bot: initial probe pass: kv 200 p95=110ms, hb 200 p95=80ms, embed 200 p95=150ms.
maria: noticed a cluster of kv-prefill 429s during the first minute, looks like synthetic retry bursts. samples: [14:20:12] 429, [14:20:13] retry->429, [14:20:14] 200.
sre-ela: that pattern means synth agent retries are compounding transient rate limits. we should avoid causing further load. propose: pause rollout at 10%, change synth retries to 1 and backoff to 3s, add a 20s warmup window.
ash (via react): +1
release-coordinator: pausing at 10% now. deploy-bot apply synth-config v1.1 (retries=1, backoff=3s, warmup=20s).
deploy-bot: synth-config applied, restarting agents on canary nodes.
(30s)
deploy-bot: post-patch probes: kv p95=120ms, hb p95=82ms, embed p95=155ms, probe-fail-rate 0.9% (5m).
maria: looks cleaner, rate-limit echoes gone.
sre-ela: recommend resume to 50% and observe 15m. alert if probe-fails >2% or p95 delta > +25% vs baseline. if persistent, pin to v2026.3.
release-coordinator: resuming to 50% now. updating release notes with synth-config change and runbook blurb.
ash: monitoring traces. will call rollback if tail latency remains up after 10m.
release-coordinator: thanks. leaving monitoring window open for 15m, closing thread if steady.
